messages:
harper: quick postmortem follow-up / heads-up that we saw a recurring pattern: token TTL creep, intermittent audit gaps for rotation events, and a handful of long-lived keys. want to assign owners, set cadence, and pick a low-risk rotation window.
oliver: +1. recommend a bi-weekly "authz hygiene" sweep for the next quarter, then move to monthly if stable. i can own the sweep scheduling and run the job.
rebecca: i'll take audit pipeline verification and retention changes. i'll also add a small end-to-end check to ensure rotation events reach the audit-store.
infra-bot: Created ticket: INFRA-5101 \u2014 authz-hygiene-sweep-schedule (https://tracker.redwood/INFRA-5101)
sec-bot: Security alert: 9 keys flagged as long-lived (>90d). Please remediate per policy.
harper: proposed TTL policy: human tokens <=30d, service tokens <=7d, ephemeral machine tokens <=24h. documenting in runbook.
oliver: CI plan: daily TTL sampler + weekly drift report. draft check below:
```bash
# ttl-sample
python tools/ttl_sampler.py --env=prod --sample=0.01 --report /tmp/ttl_report.json
```
will add an alert if >0.5% exceed thresholds.
rebecca: audit tasks: bump default retention to 180d for infra logs and 365d for enterprise. i'll open INFRA-5102 for retention work and link INFRA-5101. also adding `rotation_event` coverage assertion in the pipeline.
infra-bot: Created ticket: INFRA-5102 \u2014 audit-retention-and-rotation-assertions (https://tracker.redwood/INFRA-5102)
harper: key renewal window: suggest Saturday 02:00 PT, small rolling batches, and a preflight consumer-check. who can run the first sweep?
rebecca: i can coordinate the first sweep if oliver's smoke passes and teams ack. aiming for 2026-04-25 02:00 PT.
oliver: timeline looks fine. i'll try to have CI + Grafana panel live by 2026-04-10.
harper: concise action list to add to the remediation tracker:
- oliver: implement TTL sampler CI + Grafana panel + >0.5% PD alert \u2014 due 2026-04-10
- rebecca: INFRA-5102 + rotation_event assertion + lead first key renewal sweep \u2014 due 2026-04-25
- harper: finalize runbook TTL defaults, cadence, and public notes to product/security \u2014 due 2026-04-03
- infra: schedule INFRA-5101 recurring authz-hygiene sweep and add rotating owner \u2014 due 2026-04-07
rebecca: i'll paste the preflight checklist into INFRA-5102 and ping downstream owners.
harper: thanks all. i'll mirror these into the remediation board and close this thread unless someone needs to keep it open. re-open here if blockers crop up :thumbsup:
